description: This Java class manages a database cursor for paginated retrieval of result set data, supporting next and close operations with fetch logic.

classes.name: CursorResultSet
classes.description: Handles cursor-based pagination over JDBC ResultSet, providing next and close functionality.

methods.name: CursorResultSet
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cursor handler with statement, cursor name, and fetch size.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Intercepts method calls to delegate to the result set or handle close/next commands.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Fetches the next row, re-executing the query if necessary.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the cursor and associated result set.

methods.name: newCursorResultSet
methods.description: Creates a new CursorResultSet wrapped as a ResultSet.
